subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Last note from me on the validated-conversion program for {Brand}, picking up the trial-to-paid and incrementality points from my earlier emails. If buying toward the billed subscriber and reading it against a holdout is on your roadmap, I can share the cohort view and a short holdout read this week, calibrated to your app. If the timing is not right, I will leave it here and step back, and you have the context for when it is useful.
register_notes: Stage 3 EN education: references the original email and the earlier stages so the thread reads as one human cascade; direct close with an easy out (releases the prospect if timing is wrong); no MobUpps figure, no illustrative flag; zero question marks; native English, no sign-off, no em-dash, no X-not-Y.
